faqs.question: Can I use the certified translation to register my marriage in Spain?
faqs.answer: A sworn translation can be used when requested by the receiving organisation. For certain public documents exchanged between EU countries, Regulation (EU) 2016/1191 simplifies authentication and a multilingual form may replace a translation. Check the requirement before ordering.

faqs.question: Does the German marriage certificate need an apostille?
faqs.answer: An apostille is not always required. Public documents covered by Regulation (EU) 2016/1191, including certain birth and marriage certificates, are exempt when presented in another EU country. Other documents or destinations may have different requirements. Consult the official guidance and the receiving organisation.
